brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage by debris, leaf litter, nesting material, and accumulated dust, clearing anything above one quarter of the free area obstructed as required by SOP-015. For this 50-year-old ONAN unit with an 853-day maintenance gap, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 if attention before the event is not possible, as outlined in MG-023. Record every de-rating applied along with its reason, value, and period in accordance with MG-021.
